sloka: कुरुष्व पितरम् पुत्र सुदृष्टम् धर्म वत्सलम् ।दुर्लभम् दर्शनम् तस्य तव वत्स भविष्यति ॥४-२०-१८॥
transliteration: kuruṣva pitaram putra sudṛṣṭam dharma vatsalam ।durlabham darśanam tasya tava vatsa bhaviṣyati ॥4-20-18॥

translations.english: 'O lord you have set out on a long journey. Kiss your son on the forehead, enjoy its sweet smell, console him and give him your message.
